title: Convert project to precompiled GitHub CLI extension (`gh-commit-crawl`)
body:
This PR reshapes the repository into a GitHub CLI extension installable as `gh extension install leereilly/gh-commit-crawl`, while preserving existing flags/behavior behind `gh commit-crawl ...`. It also adds extension-native release packaging and non-interactive auth sourcing (`GITHUB_TOKEN` or `gh auth token`) for contribution graph generation.

- **Extension packaging + binary shape**
  - Moved the executable entrypoint to repository root so extension builds use `go build -o gh-commit-crawl .`.
  - Renamed module/import path to `github.com/leereilly/gh-commit-crawl`.
  - Updated command-facing strings/user agent to the new extension identity.

- **Auth behavior for extension runtime**
  - Added token discovery flow for graph generation: use `GITHUB_TOKEN` first, then `gh auth token`.
  - Added authenticated HTTP transport when a token is available, avoiding interactive token prompting in extension usage.

- **Release automation for `gh extension upgrade`**
  - Added `.github/workflows/release.yml` using `cli/gh-extension-precompile@v2`.
  - Configured tag-triggered cross-platform precompiled release artifacts via Go module settings.

- **README updates for extension UX**
  - Added extension install instructions.
  - Switched usage examples to `gh commit-crawl ...`.
  - Added extension upgrade command guidance.

```go
func githubToken(ctx context.Context) string {
	if token := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN")); token != "" {
		return token
	}
	token, err := ghAuthToken(ctx) // gh auth token
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(token)
}
```

<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

Convert this repository into a GitHub CLI extension named gh-commit-crawl.

Requirements:

- Rename the binary to gh-commit-crawl so it can be installed with gh extension install leereilly/gh-commit-crawl.
- Update go.mod (module path → github.com/leereilly/gh-commit-crawl), the main package, and any build scripts/Makefile/GoReleaser config to produce a gh-commit-crawl binary for linux/macOS/windows on amd64 and arm64.
- When run as a gh extension, use gh auth token (or the GITHUB_TOKEN env var) for authentication instead of prompting for a token.
- Add a precompiled-extension release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml) using cli/gh-extension-precompile so gh extension upgrade works.
- Update the README with installation (gh extension install leereilly/gh-commit-crawl), usage (gh commit-crawl ...), and upgrade instructions.
- Keep existing commands/flags working; just make sure they're invoked via gh commit-crawl <subcommand>.

Verify by running go build -o gh-commit-crawl . and ./gh-commit-crawl --help.

</details>
